answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 37214 Country: United Kingdom Title: My Question is women must do Azan and Iqamah before doing their fardh salah as a jamah? Question: My Question is women must do Azan and Iqamah before doing their fardh salah as a jamah? Answer ID: 37214 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 505/304/D=1433) It is makrooh tahrimi for women to do jamah alone. It is also makrooh tahrimi for them to do azan and iqamah. قال فى الدر المختار ويكره تحريما جماعة النساء ولوفى التراويح قال فى الشامى صرح به اى بالكراهة التحريمة فى الفتح والبحر . (شامي جلد 1 ، ص: 418) و قال فى الدر المختار ويكره ..... اذان امرأة (شامى جلد 1 ، ص:289) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
